stories.title: Making Tax Digital to Extend to Sole Traders and Landlords Earning Over £30,000
stories.summary: HMRC's Making Tax Digital for Income Tax will extend from April 2027 to sole traders and landlords earning more than £30,000 per year. Businesses are being urged to begin preparations now.

stories.title: Foreign Tax Authority Requests to HMRC Hit Seven-Year High
stories.summary: HM Revenue and Customs received 1,772 targeted information requests from foreign tax authorities in 2025 — a 20% increase since 2022 — as overseas offices intensify scrutiny of wealthy UK taxpayers.

stories.title: HMRC Updates Draft Guidance on Mandatory Payrolling of Benefits in Kind
stories.summary: HMRC has updated its draft interim guidance on the mandatory payrolling of benefits in kind and expenses, with globally mobile employees specifically excluded from the new requirements.

stories.title: Home Secretary Reopens UK Resettlement Scheme for Afghan and Palestinian Refugees
stories.summary: The Home Secretary has announced the reopening of the UK Resettlement Scheme, with around a quarter of referrals expected to be Afghan women and girls and Palestinian refugees fleeing conflict.

stories.title: UK International Climate Finance Results 2026 Published
stories.summary: The government published results highlighting key achievements of UK International Climate Finance from 2011 to 2026, covering 15 key measures of impact from UK aid spending on climate.

stories.title: FCDO Climate and Nature Diplomacy Fund Backs Pre-COP31 Pacific Engagement
stories.summary: The FCDO's Climate and Nature Diplomacy Fund is supporting Pacific leaders and climate voices at Pre-COP31, which began today in the lead-up to the main COP31 climate summit.

stories.title: Chevening Scholarship Spotlights ASEAN Governance Cooperation
stories.summary: Singapore's first ASEAN-Chevening Scholar, Danial Hakim, is exploring public governance, resilience and regional cooperation at Oxford, highlighting FCDO's scholarship diplomacy in Southeast Asia.

stories.title: Free Careers Support Now Available Through Jobcentres
stories.summary: The Department for Work and Pensions has launched a new free careers support service available to jobseekers through Jobcentres across the UK, aimed at helping people back into employment.

stories.title: Youth Hub Opens in Rossendale to Help Young People into Work
stories.summary: A new Youth Hub has opened in Rossendale, offering tailored support for young people seeking employment. The hub is part of a broader DWP initiative to tackle youth unemployment in deprived areas.

stories.title: APHA Launches Free Virtual Work Experience on Animal and Plant Disease Prevention
stories.summary: The Animal and Plant Health Agency (APHA), part of the Defra family, has launched a free virtual work experience programme to inspire the next generation of biosecurity professionals to help stop disease outbreaks.

stories.title: New MRSA Strain Spreading from Pigs to Humans Raises Biosecurity Concerns
stories.summary: Campaigners are calling for urgent testing of UK farm animals following the emergence of a new MRSA strain that has spread rapidly among farmers, raising concerns about livestock biosecurity and public health.

stories.title: Soldier Commended for Going to Aid of Sick Driver
stories.summary: Private Dan Montgomery has been awarded the Catterick Garrison Commander's Commendation by the Ministry of Defence after going to the aid of a stricken driver in a medical emergency.

stories.title: First Ever National Cadets Week Inspires Young People to Connect with Armed Forces
stories.summary: The UK's first National Cadets Week has been launched to inspire young people to engage with the armed forces, highlighting the role of cadet organisations in building skills and community ties.

stories.title: Government Responds to National Commission on AI Regulation in Healthcare
stories.summary: The government published its formal response to the National Commission's recommendations on AI regulation in healthcare, confirming that BIST will support sandbox provisions in the upcoming Regulating for Growth Bill.

stories.title: UK Reviews Tariffs on Chinese Car Imports to Align with EU
stories.summary: The UK government is reviewing whether to impose tariffs on Chinese electric vehicle imports, following the EU's move to protect domestic manufacturing from lower-cost Chinese competition.

stories.title: Government Publishes Unpaid Carers Action Plan
stories.summary: BIST has published an action plan — 'Recognise, Refer, Reach' — setting out government commitments to better support the UK's unpaid carers through improved recognition and referral pathways.

stories.title: NHS Cuts Armed Forces Waiting Times by Over a Month in Targeted Campaign
stories.summary: The NHS has reduced waiting times for serving soldiers, sailors and air crew by more than four weeks through a targeted campaign to treat injured military personnel more quickly and efficiently.

stories.title: Government Forms Three-Year Partnership with Breast Cancer Now
stories.summary: The UK government has announced a new three-year partnership with Breast Cancer Now to deliver breast cancer awareness campaigns and provide trusted health information for women across the country.

stories.title: New Endoscopy Service Gives Patients Greater Choice at Royal Wolverhampton NHS Trust
stories.summary: Patients at Royal Wolverhampton NHS Trust are benefiting from a new innovative endoscopy service offering a less invasive experience than traditional procedures for investigating bowel conditions.

stories.title: Reading MPs Write to Royal Mail Over Widespread Missed Post Complaints
stories.summary: Three Labour MPs representing Reading constituencies have written an open letter to Royal Mail after receiving numerous complaints from constituents about missed post and failed deliveries.

stories.title: Over 10,000 Items of 'Stolen' Royal Mail Post Found in Postal Worker's Home
stories.summary: More than 10,000 items of undelivered Royal Mail post were discovered at the home of a postal worker, highlighting ongoing concerns about mail theft and delivery reliability.

stories.title: Royal Mail Delays Force Residents to Collect Their Own Post
stories.summary: Persistent Royal Mail delivery delays in the Winchcombe area have become severe enough that residents are travelling to collect their own post, adding to parliamentary and public pressure on the service.
